Java crash pages 10: tip structured error with Java's message on 9; sur_link_title_escape renders normally in every tree (class link titles do not decode <U+XXXX>; declared, pre-existing). sur_state_link_title_escape is a new tip error vs round 2 and is correct (Java crashes with 'd83e d83e').

AW surrogate_*: surrogate_high_class now matches (the round-2 rejection is answered), surrogate_unused_variable / rejoined_pair / in_comment_line match, surrogate_upper_sequence and surrogate_activity_label exit 1 with Java's messages.

Corpus: base->tip 0 new valid-input errors, 0 lost rejections, 0 new panics; round-2 tip->tip the only non-state change is surrogate_high_class (gained). No tip SVG output in the 16441-source sweep, BB, or 15 checker leak probes across families contains a carrier scalar or a carrier-range character reference.

Carrier collision (Rust-measured; Java references staged as c3a, not yet run): class 'Vault U+10FFFD' -> tip exit 1 'An invalid XML character (Unicode: 0xdffd)'; 'Gate U+10F800 end' -> exit 1 'Invalid UTF-16 surrogate detected: d800 20 ?'; sequence U+10FFF0, activity U+10FC10, usecase U+10FB00 -> exit 1; state 'Mark U+10FA00' and title 'Ledger U+10F900' -> exit 0 with the character silently removed; 'Rune U+10F83D U+10FE80' -> rendered as U+1F680 with textLength 57.459 (base 66.459); %strlen(U+10FFFD) -> 1. Base renders every one of these (strlen panics in base). Java source: XML 1.0 Char admits #x10000-#x10FFFF, accumDefaultEscape writes a high+low pair as &#N; (ToStream.java 1735), CharHidder.unhideChar maps only U+E000..U+E0FF, and String.length() counts 2 units, so Java renders all of them normally.

The declared residue ('user literals in U+10F800..U+10FFFF are read as carried units') understates the effect: it is not an exotic mis-measurement but new errors and silent text substitution for valid Unicode input, in a shipping crate.

Formats: for BB sur_class_low_end / sur_activity_low_end the tip exits 1 on -tpng/-tpdf/-teps with 'SVG parse error: SVG data parsing failed cause the document does not have a root node' (base exit 0); for sur_class_high_end the tip renders them with the high unit dropped. --yaml prints raw carrier scalars (2 per output), -ttxt 1, --ast prints \u{10f83e}-style escapes.

Comments: svg::comment_text writes '?' per Rust char (Java's StreamEncoder REPLACE gives one '?' per unmappable unit or pair); several family writers format `<!--{}-->` from pre-built strings and svg_export leaves comments untouched, so a carrier reaching a comment unconverted would leak, but none did in any measured output.

Seeds: svg_id_seed_prefix and filter_registry::plantuml_seed now hash UTF-16 units via java_utf16::units, which fixes astral characters (Java charAt) but hashes a legitimate U+10F800..U+10FFFF character as one unit instead of Java's two.
